capabilities.name: Top-K Recommendation Replication

algorithms.name: Item-Based Collaborative Filtering
algorithms.description: Recommend unseen items using item-item similarity from user co-occurrence.

algorithms.name: Genre Affinity Recommender
algorithms.description: Recommend unseen items by matching user interaction genres with candidate item genres.

algorithms.name: Popularity Baseline
algorithms.description: Global item popularity ranking filtered by user history.

metrics.name: NDCG@K
metrics.description: Position-sensitive ranking quality for Top-K recommendation.

metrics.name: Recall@K
metrics.description: Fraction of held-out relevant items found in the Top-K list.

metrics.name: Coverage
metrics.description: Unique recommended items divided by unique catalog items.

constraints.name: Implicit Feedback Only

constraints.name: Local CPU Execution
constraints.description: Algorithm must run on local CPU without external services.
